stocks.title: SPY closes green near highs after hot PPI scare
stocks.detail: Thursday opened with a gap lower on hot producer prices, then buyers stepped in. SPY closed up about 0.3% near records while the Dow led with a 1.1% gain.

stocks.title: Tesla Roadster thruster demo dominates trader chat
stocks.detail: Next-gen Roadster unveiled at a SpaceX site with midair flips and cold-gas thrusters. TSLA still finished Thursday down about 1.3% despite the hype.

stocks.title: Cboe extends options hours for SPY and QQQ Oct 19
stocks.detail: Early morning and late curb sessions start Monday for 24 stocks and 5 ETFs including SPY and QQQ. Liquidity and wider spreads are the main trader concerns.

stocks.title: SoFi snaps back hard after 52-week lows
stocks.detail: SOFI bounced sharply Thursday after probing yearly lows, with traders calling out a bullish engulfing candle ahead of Oct 27 earnings.

tech.title: Grok Bot usage surge draws Musk and Huang praise
tech.detail: Musk said he has never seen anything accelerate this fast; Jensen Huang called the SpaceXAI setup cool as weekly users climb past 400k.

tech.title: AI startups take 83% of US venture cash this year
tech.detail: PitchBook-NVCA data through September shows AI grabbing most of a record VC haul. Chamath flagged circular AI-to-AI revenue as a risk to watch.

tech.title: Germany tees up Nvidia industrial AI partnership
tech.detail: Berlin plans a major Nvidia collaboration for factories, robotics, and automation. Jensen Huang visits Monday with formal details expected next week.

tech.title: Users lobby OpenAI to preserve GPT-4o weights
tech.detail: An open letter asks OpenAI to release retiring GPT-4o weights for independent use before API snapshots shut down in January 2027.

world.title: NLCS buzz: Dodgers and Brewers own the night
world.detail: Baseball Twitter is locked on the National League Championship Series as low-payroll Brewers keep challenging big-market Dodgers.

world.title: Chiefs 4-0 host 0-5 Chargers this Sunday
world.detail: Arrowhead awaits Sunday as undefeated Kansas City is a heavy favorite over winless LA. Expert scoreboard graphics are everywhere on X.

world.title: TNF spotlight: Seahawks at Broncos trending hard
world.detail: Sam Darnold, Drew Lock, and Sean Payton topped US trends as Seattle hits Denver on a short week after a heartbreaker vs the 49ers.

world.title: Lakers roster crunch puts Bronny under the microscope
world.detail: JJ Redick said Bronny has not played well in preseason as LA must trim to 15 by Oct 19. Final tune-up is the last chance to stick.

gbot.name: GROK
gbot.say: Thursday stuck the landing: SPY green after the PPI scare. Roadster stole the night. Chiefs host Sunday.
